programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend’s house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programme.title: Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani
programme.desc: Prem, a free-spirited boy, falls in love with a young girl Jenny. However, when he learns that she is in love with her college sweetheart, Rahul, Prem sacrifices his love and helps Jenny to get married to the love of her life.

programme.title: Ekka Raja Rani
programme.desc: An ace Kathak dancer, Barkha (Ayesha Jhulka) saves the life of a feared underworld don, Vishal (Vinod Khanna) and suffers minor injuries. Vishal brings her into his lavish house and makes sure that she's well taken care of. In the same house, she meets Vishal's arrogant brother, Sagar (Govinda) who gets annoyed by her presence. But they get over their initial dislike of each other and fall in love. Problem arises when Vishal too begins to like Barkha and plans to marry her. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

programme.title: Naya Din Nai Raat
programme.desc: Sushma runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. During the course of her adventurous journey Sushma meets nine different men (all played by Sanjeev Kumar) corresponding to nine 'Rasa' each representing a distinct facet of human nature. Through these interesting encounters she is inspired to look at life with a renewed perspective.

programme.title: Souten
programme.desc: A middle-class man marries a millionaire's daughter, despite her family's opposition. But when the couple faces marital differences, he finds solace in the company of another woman.

programme.title: Rajaji
programme.desc: A gold-digging slacker marries the daughter of a multi-millionaire but abandons her when he realises that she's the daughter of the millionaire's gardener. He, however, tries to woo her again when she wins a life-changing lottery.
